label.responsibilities:
Develop and maintain backend systems using PHP Laravel.
Build and maintain RESTful APIs.
Work with relational databases such as MySQL / PostgreSQL.
Participate in code reviews, bug fixing, and performance optimization.
Collaborate with frontend, QA, and other team members.
label.requirements:
1+ year of experience with PHP Laravel (or strong fresher with real projects).
Solid understanding of: MVC, OOP concepts, Laravel (Routing, Eloquent ORM, Migrations), RESTful APIs and HTTP.
Self-motivated, proactive, and responsible mindset.
Familiar with Git and clean code practices.
